items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: They had a little act, so we got them and Charlie would play the guitar and Jerry would stand up in front of the band.

ctx.x: At that time, Lacey got this trouble and there was this thing called Charlie and Jerry.
They had a little act, so we got them and Charlie would play the guitar and Jerry would stand up in front of the band. We always liked to have somebody up front.
